nodes.title: Joining the ABCD-Centre
nodes.text: Every river starts somewhere. This one starts when our traveller joined the first cohort of a joint Master's in Water Security and Global Change: five institutions, one river to follow. Two older trails meet at this camp, a mechanical engineer's and the years spent as a data scientist and developer, and both walk on from here.
nodes.sceneDescription: [PLACEHOLDER-IMG] Base camp in a river valley before dawn; two side trails join the path ahead.

nodes.title: Contaminant Transport Modelling
nodes.text: Watch what the current carries. In Contaminant Transport Modelling our traveller learned to follow a river's passengers: where they travel, and where they come to rest.
nodes.sceneDescription: [PLACEHOLDER-IMG] Stones and sediment drifting down the river, some settling on the bed.

nodes.title: Sustainable River Basin Management
nodes.text: A river is never only water. Walking the Cooum River basin in Chennai, point by point, our traveller listened to the people who live along it, and drew the chain of causes that ties a river's troubles together.
nodes.sceneDescription: [PLACEHOLDER-IMG] A village along the river; a mill's water wheel turning with the current.

nodes.title: Physicochemical Treatment of Wastewater
nodes.text: The sails turn, and water that was spoiled is made fit to return. Physicochemical Treatment of Wastewater: the patient chemistry of giving water back.
nodes.sceneDescription: [PLACEHOLDER-IMG] A windmill on a rise above the valley, sails turning.

nodes.title: Climate Adaptation and Coastal Engineering
nodes.text: Look right: the sea, for the first time, far off on the horizon. It is where this river is going. In Climate Adaptation and Coastal Engineering our traveller studied how coasts can hold as the climate changes.
nodes.sceneDescription: [PLACEHOLDER-IMG] Gulls wheeling over land that falls away to a distant sea.

nodes.title: Groundwater Engineering
nodes.text: Not all water runs where we can see it. In Groundwater Engineering our traveller went looking beneath the ground, and brought it up.
nodes.sceneDescription: [PLACEHOLDER-IMG] A well near the river; a figure, seen from behind, hauling up the bucket.

nodes.title: The first semester ends
nodes.text: At the foot of the mountain, the first semester is done. The valley lies behind; the climb begins.
nodes.sceneDescription: [PLACEHOLDER-IMG] The foot of the mountain: limestone towers above a stony bowl, the hut below.
